name: Porcelain Cradle Sanctuary
core_rationale: Innermost vitrified white-clay amphitheater of Continent 01 where Sola's unbroken ceramic boss-medallion radiates warm hearth-light beneath the central lake.
local_conflict: Luminous glaze-sprites and ancient kiln-wardens guard the inner sanctuary where Hearth-Sparks first condense.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Boiling lotus-glaze steam curtains seal the northern Lotus Kiln Rim; Loom-Mother Cera requires the Medallion Heart-Chime before opening the northern terrace.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Lantern-Keepers say that when the central pond in Lantern Hollow is completely still, you can see the white-gold roofs of Porcelain Cradle reflected below.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A sunken amphitheater of translucent white porcelain domes glowing softly beneath shallow warm springs.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What sleeps beyond the steaming Lotus Kiln Rim at the northern edge of Porcelain Cradle Sanctuary?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin at the innermost core of Continent 01 and connects West to Draft-Kiln Post.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Translucent white porcelain domes and musical celadon bridges glowing beneath warm spring-water at the center of Sola's shield.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m celadon-glazed causeways, 0.58m porcelain tea-counters, and 0.14m stepping-stones for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: 2x2 grid connects Celadon Causeway, Porcelain Loom Sanctuary, and Medallion Heart Vault B1 across [10, 15] with spirit and construct families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-lotus-kiln-rim at [1, 0] as a Mystery frontier behind a fog_of_lore portal on Porcelain Loom Sanctuary.
